description: Read watched Jotai atoms and their available labels, change counts and writable status. includeValues:true requests values. Use get_events with sources:["jotai"] for retained changes.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeValues.description: Include each atom's current value (HEAVY). Default false.

name: get_jotai_state
